headword: {産学協同|さんがくきょうどう}

definitions.explanation: Joint work between companies and universities on research, technology development, and training. {産|さん} is industry and {学|がく} is academia.

examples.japanese: {産学協同|さんがくきょうどう}の{研究|けんきゅう}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Industry-academia joint research is moving forward.

examples.japanese: この{製品|せいひん}は{産学協同|さんがくきょうどう}で{生|う}まれた。
examples.english: This product came out of industry-academia cooperation.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}は{地元|じもと}{企業|きぎょう}との{産学協同|さんがくきょうどう}によって、{学生|がくせい}に{実習|じっしゅう}の{場|ば}を{用意|ようい}している。
examples.english: Through industry-academia cooperation with local companies, the university provides students with places to gain practical experience.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {産学協同|さんがくきょうどう}{研究|けんきゅう}: joint industry-academia research
- {産学協同|さんがくきょうどう}の{取|と}り{組|く}み: an industry-academia initiative
- {産学協同|さんがくきょうどう}で{開発|かいはつ}する: to develop jointly with a university

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {産学連携|さんがくれんけい}: the current standard term in government and university policy documents
- {産官学|さんかんがく}: industry, government, and academia — the three-way version, often {産官学連携|さんかんがくれんけい}

Historically {産学協同|さんがくきょうどう} was the older term and was criticized in the 1960s student movement as subordinating universities to business; {産学連携|さんがくれんけい} is now preferred in official use.
